name: focused
description: Finds your answers in a long session. Indexes each message, split into its parts, and everything Claude wrote in reply, wake-ups included. With Jev switched on, /focused:answers shows each part with the paragraphs that answer it; /focused:find searches it all. After /clear and compaction, a summary of where the session left off is loaded. After an hour without a reply, the first message you type is stopped once, so you can /clear first. The index stays on this machine, in ~/.claude/focused, unless you set up the hosted index on your own Cloudflare account (focused-context-worker), which every session can read back.
